notes.title: Patch 01 – Important Fixes & Improvements! + 10% Discount for 7 Days! 👷‍♂️🚜
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👷‍♂️🚜

We’ve been working hard to improve your experience in Road Maintenance Simulator 2 + Winter Services. Patch 01 brings numerous fixes and optimizations. Thanks for your feedback – we’ve implemented many of your suggestions! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147485/bd8aa34621dac0406d4a33c29ab60e415d731196.png[/img]

[b]🔧 Fixed Issues:[/b]

[*]  Stability: Crashes have been fixed for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Task Markers: No more duplicate or missing markers.
[*] Cleaning Tasks: No more unreachable piles of trash.
[*] UI & HUD: Correct symbols for vehicle inputs and more accurate markers.
[*] Animations: The secretary's animations are now smoother.
[*] Settings & Saves: Fixed issues with audio, graphics, and input settings.
[*] Vehicles: No more flying or teleporting vehicles – and entering them works properly again.
[*] Task Logic: Improvements in road construction, cleaning, and winter tasks.
[*] Physics: Attachments and roadblocks stay where they should.

[b]🆕 New Features & Adjustments:[/b]

[*] Better Overview: Task-related vehicles are now visible on the map.
[*] Improved Menu Texts: Long texts now scroll at a more comfortable speed.
[*] Optimized HUD: More info for tools like the hand compactor and high-pressure cleaner.

[b]🎉 Get it now! -10% Discount for 7 Days! 🎉[/b]
If you haven’t tried it yet – now’s the perfect time to jump into Road Maintenance Simulator 2 + Winter Services! Get the game now with a 10% discount, but only for the next 7 days! 🏁

We hope you enjoy the improvements and look forward to your feedback! 🚧 Thank you for your support!

Have fun on the road! 🏗️
